title: Wild Arms spiritual successor Armed Fantasia discontinued by publisher despite successful 2022 crowdfunding campaign
summary: 505 Games’ parent company Digital Bros has discontinued development of Armed Fantasia, the spiritual successor to Media.Vision’s Wild Arms series. The company made the statement in its financial results for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026, alongside cancellations of Directorate: Novitiate and a Battle Island sequel. According to the document, the projects were discontinued following multiple gameplay revision attempts and a “thorough review of each product,” including their current development progress, potential markets, and required additional funding.
